UnitAbilities.Title: Invulnerable Save
UnitAbilities.Text: This model has a 4+ invulnerable save.

UnitAbilities.Title: Cold and Calculating
UnitAbilities.Text:
In your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when this unit is selected to attack, you can select one of the following for this unit’s attacks to have:


- [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].
- Or: [Sustained Hits 1: non-[Monster/Vehicle]
- Or: If the tactical doctrine is active for this unit, [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle] and [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle]

UnitAbilities.Title: Cerebrex Logic Engine
UnitAbilities.Text: In the Declare Battle Formations step, you can select one friendly **ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY** unit. That unit has Scouts 6".

UnitAbilities.Title: Rites of Tempering
UnitAbilities.Text: Attacks that target this unit with a S greater than this unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

UnitAbilities.Title: Iron Father
UnitAbilities.Text: While this model is within 3" of a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit, this model has Lone Operative.

UnitAbilities.Title: Master of the Forge
UnitAbilities.Text:
In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit’s move, you can select one friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle model within 3" of this model:


- That Vehicle model heals 3 wounds.
- That Vehicle model’s attacks can ignore modifiers to the following until the start of your next Movement phase:
- BS.
- Hit rolls and wound rolls.

Rule.Title: Codex Discipline
Rule.Text: You can select one Combat Doctrine one additional time per battle.

Enhancements.Name: Artificer Armour
Enhancements.Description:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model has:
▪ 2+ Sv
▪  Feel No Pain 5+

Enhancements.Name: Laurels of Triumph
Enhancements.Description:
Adeptus Astartes model only. This model's melee attacks have:
▪ +1S and AP
▪ Or: if the assault doctrine is active for this unit, +2S and AP

Enhancements.Name: Adept of the Codex
Enhancements.Description: Captain model only. The tactical doctrine is active for this unit in addition to any other combat doctrine

Enhancements.Name: Standard of the Emperor Ascendant
Enhancements.Description:
Ancient Model only. This model has:
▪ +1OC and Ld
▪ Feel No Pain 5+
▪ The following ability:
Ancient Exhortation (Once per battle, per army). When this unit is selected to fight, you can use this ability. If you do, this unit's melee attacks have +1A until the end of the phase.

Rule.Title: Ironstorm Auto-Targeters
Rule.Text:
Friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle units' (excluding Walker units) ranged attacks can:
▪ Re-roll one hit roll
▪ Re-roll one wound roll

Enhancements.Name: Gunnery Honours (Upgrade)
Enhancements.Description: Adeptus Astartes Vehicle unit only (excluding Dedicated Transport/Fly/Walker units). This unit's ranged attacks have [Heavy]

Enhancements.Name: Redoubtable Machine Spirit (Upgrade)
Enhancements.Description:
Adeptus Astartes Vehicle unit only (excluding Dedicated Transport/Fly/Walker units) This unit:
▪ Has a 5+ InvSv
▪ At the end of your Command phase, heals 1 wound

Rule.Title: Lightning-Fast Strike
Rule.Text: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Speeder units have +2"M

Enhancements.Name: Supercharged Engines (Upgrade)
Enhancements.Description: Adeptus Astartes Mounted unit only. This unit can re-roll advance rolls.

Enhancements.Name: Auspex Triangulation Shrines (Upgrade)
Enhancements.Description:
Adeptus Astartes Speeder unit only. At the start of your Shooting phase, select one visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit. That enemy is spotted.
▪ While a unit is spotted, that unit has +3" detection range

Rule.Title: Assault Mastery
Rule.Text: You can select the assault doctrine one additional time per battle

Enhancements.Name: Furious Assault (Upgrade)
Enhancements.Description: Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit only. This unit's melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle]

Rule.Title: Tactical Mastery
Rule.Text: You can select the Tactical Doctrine one additional time.

Enhancements.Name: Laurels of Vigilance
Enhancements.Description: Adeptus Astartes model only. (Once per battle round per army) When you use the Fire Overwatch/Heroic Intervention stratagem, if you target a friendly Adeptus Astartes Battleline unit within 12" of this model with that stratagem, that use is -1CP

Enhancements.Name: Tactical Insight
Enhancements.Description: Captain model only. The tactical doctrine is active for this unit in addition to any other combat doctrine

Rule.Title: Devastator Mastery
Rule.Text: You can select the devastator doctrine one additional time per battle.

Enhancements.Name: Honour of Vigilance
Enhancements.Description:
Adeptus Astartes model only.
▪ This unit's ranged attacks have [Lethal Hits]
▪ If the devastator doctrine is active for this unit, this unit can re-roll advance rolls.

Enhancements.Name: Master-Forged Firearms
Enhancements.Description: Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted model only. This model's ranged attacks (excluding [Psychic] attacks) have +1A, S, AP and D.

Rule.Title: Death Blow
Rule.Text: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Terminator units have +1 to charge rolls

Enhancements.Name: Champion of the First Company
Enhancements.Description: Adeptus Astartes Terminator model only. This unit's melee attacks have [Lethal Hits]

Enhancements.Name: Corporeum Reliquary
Enhancements.Description: Adeptus Astartes Terminator model only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

Rule.Title: Wrath of the Chapter
Rule.Text: Friendly Tacticus units can re-roll advance rolls.

Enhancements.Name: Martial Paragon
Enhancements.Description:
Tacticus model only. This unit's attacks can:
▪ Re-roll one hit roll
▪ Re-roll one wound roll.

Enhancements.Name: Spearpoint War Leader
Enhancements.Description: Tacticus model only. This unit has Scouts 6"

Rule.Title: Codex Fire-Patterns
Rule.Text: Friendly Tacticus units [Rapid Fire] attacks benefit from [Rapid Fire] when targeting units up to that attack's maximum range.

Enhancements.Name: Cyber Familiar
Enhancements.Description: Tacticus model only. When both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly Adeptus Astartes units. When doing so, you can set those units up in strategic reserves, regardless of how many units are already in strategic reserves.

Enhancements.Name: Tempered in Battle (Aura)
Enhancements.Description: Tacticus model only. Friendly Adeptus Astartes units within 6" of this model can re-roll leadership rolls.

Rule.Title: Shadow Masters
Rule.Text:
When a Phobos or Scout Squad unit has shot:
▪ Those attacks do not prevent that unit from being hidden
▪ Or: That unit can make a normal move of up to D6". That unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

Enhancements.Name: Execute and Redeploy
Enhancements.Description: Phobos model only. In your shooting phase, after this unit has shot, if this unit is unengaged, this unit can make a normal move of up to 6". If it does, this unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

Enhancements.Name: Venator Omni-Auspex
Enhancements.Description:
Phobos model only. This unit's attacks that target a hidden units can:
▪ Re-roll wound rolls of 1
▪ Or: If the assault  doctrine is active for this unit, re-roll wound rolls of 1 and 2

Rule.Title: Vanguard Ambushers
Rule.Text: At the end of your Movement phase, if a friendly Phobos unit is hidden, that unit’s attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1 until the end of the turn.

Enhancements.Name: Seal of Shrouding
Enhancements.Description: Phobos model only. Enemy units cannot target this unit with snap shooting attacks.

Enhancements.Name: Venator Omni-Auspex
Enhancements.Description:
Phobos model only. This unit's attacks that target a hidden units can:
▪ Re-roll wound rolls of 1
▪ Or: If the assault  doctrine is active for this unit, re-roll wound rolls of 1 and 2

Rule.Title: Walking Fortress
Rule.Text:
In a turn a friendly Gravis unit made a normal move, that unit's ranged attacks:
▪ Do not have [Heavy]
▪ Have +1 to hit rolls

Enhancements.Name: Indefatigable Fortitude
Enhancements.Description: Gravis model only. Attacks that target this unit with a S greater than this unit's T have -1 to wound rolls.

Enhancements.Name: Relentless Advance
Enhancements.Description: Gravis model only. This unit has Scouts 5"

Rule.Title: Indomitable Defence
Rule.Text: While a friendly Gravis unit is within range of an objective, attacks that target that unit with a S greater than that unit's T have -1 to wound rolls

Enhancements.Name: Immovable Conquerors (Upgrade)
Enhancements.Description: Gravis unit only. This unit has +1 OC

Enhancements.Name: Narthecis Gauntlet
Enhancements.Description: Apothecary Biologis model only. In your Command phase, this unit heals D3+1 wounds.

Rule.Title: Enduring Vengeance
Rule.Text: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Dreadnought units can re-roll hit rolls of 1

Enhancements.Name: Artificer Sarcophagus (Upgrade)
Enhancements.Description: Dreadnought unit only. Attacks that target this unit have -1D

Enhancements.Name: Venerable Champion (Aura) (Upgrade)
Enhancements.Description: Dreadnought unit only. While a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit is within 6" of this unit, that unit's attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1

Rule.Title: Combined Deployment
Rule.Text:
In your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Transport unit has shot, you can select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is assailed until the end of the turn.
▪ While a unit is assailed, when an Adeptus Astartes unit that disembarked this turn targets that unit, those attacks have [Sustained Hits 1]

Enhancements.Name: Linebreaker Onslaught
Enhancements.Description:
Adeptus Astartes Infantry model only. If this unit disembarked this turn:
▪ This unit can re-roll charge rolls
▪ Enemy units cannot target this unit with snap shooting attacks.

Enhancements.Name: Damocles-Class Uplink
Enhancements.Description: Captain model only. In your Movement phase, if this unit is embarked within a Transport unit, you can select one friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit within 6" of that Transport unit and select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for that Infantry unit.

Rule.Title: New Rule
Rule.Text:
Each time a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot or selected to fight apply one of the following when resolving those attacks:


▪ If that unit is within 6" of a friendly Cannok Var/Iron Father Feirros unit you can:
  ▪ Re-roll one hit roll.
  ▪ Re-roll one wound roll.
  ▪ Re-roll one damage roll.
▪ Otherwise you can:
  ▪ Re-roll one hit roll.
  ▪ Or: Re-roll one wound roll.
  ▪ Or: Re-roll one damage roll.

Enhancements.Name: Adept of the Omnissiah
Enhancements.Description: TECHMARINE model only. (Once per battle round, per army) When an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit within 6” of this unit, you can use this ability. If you do, that VEHICLE unit has Feel No Pain 5+ until that enemy unit has attacked.

Enhancements.Name: Master of the Machine War
Enhancements.Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. In your Movement phase, you can select one visible friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit within 6” of this model and then select the devastator doctrine or tactical doctrine. That doctrine is active for that VEHICLE unit until the start of your next Command phase.

Enhancements.Name: Target Augury Web
Enhancements.Description: TECHMARINE model only. In your movement phase, at the start or end of this unit’s move, you can select one friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE model within 3" of this unit. That VEHICLE model’s attacks have [LETHAL HITS] until the start of your next Command phase

Enhancements.Name: The Flesh is Weak
Enhancements.Description:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model:


▪ Has +1 T.
▪ Has Feel No Pain 5+.

Rule.Title: Mission Tactics
Rule.Text:
Friendly KILL TEAM units with this ability have the following abilities:


Furor Tactics: If the devastator doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].


Malleus Tactics: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks have [LETHAL HITS].


Purgatus Tactics: If the assault doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks that target an enemy unit within 9" of this unit have [PRECISION].


DEATHWATCH ALLIES


You can include Deathwatch units in your army, even though they do not have the same Chapter faction keyword as other units in your army. The combined points value of such units cannot exceed 500 points.


When mustering your army, unless otherwise stated, you cannot select a Deathwatch model to be your Warlord. In addition Kill Team units can only contain enhancements taken from this detachment.

Rule.Title: Bold Gallantry
Rule.Text:
Each time an **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS** unit from your army Advances, until the end of the turn, ranged weapons equipped by **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS** models from your army have the **[ASSAULT]** ability.

**Assault**

Units containing one or more models with an **[ASSAULT]** weapon can shoot using **assault shooting** (10.05).

Enhancements.Name: Bearer of the Iron Chalice
Enhancements.Description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. At the end of your Movement phase, select one other IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model from your army that is within 12" of and visible to the bearer. That selected model regains up to D3 lost wounds, or up to 3 lost wounds if your army is Honoured.

Enhancements.Name: Bearer of the Evanescent Ion
Enhancements.Description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. At the end of your Movement phase, select one other IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model from your army that is within 12" of and visible to the bearer. Until the start of your next Movement phase, that selected model has the Stealth ability.

Enhancements.Name: Bearer of the Judicant's Helm
Enhancements.Description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, select one other IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model from your army that is within 12" of and visible to the bearer. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by that selected model have the **[IGNORES COVER]** ability.

Enhancements.Name: Bearer of the Lancer's Sigil
Enhancements.Description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. At the start of your Charge phase, select one other IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model from your army that is within 12" of and visible to the bearer. Until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Charge rolls made for that selected model.

Rule.Title: Cogbound Alliance
Rule.Text:
Friendly **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS** models have the **Assisted Targeting (Aura)** ability.

Friendly **TECH-PRIEST** models have the **Sacristan Pledge** ability:

**Mechanicus Allies**

You can include **TECH-PRIEST DOMINUS/TECH-PRIEST MANIPULUS/MARSHAL/RANGERS/VANGUARD** units in your army. The combined points value of such units cannot exceed 500 points.

Enhancements.Name: Magos Questoris
Enhancements.Description: **TECH-PRIEST** model only. When using this model’s **Sacristan Pledge** ability, the selected **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS** model **heals** 2 additional wounds.

Enhancements.Name: Knight of the Opus Machina (Aura)
Enhancements.Description: **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS** model only. While a friendly **ADEPTUS MECHANICUS** unit is within 6" of this model, that **ADEPTUS MECHANICUS** unit’s melee attacks have +1 **WS** and **AP**.

Rule.Title: Dauntless Defenders
Rule.Text:
At the start of the first battle round, select two objectives to be your foundations. Place a circular 40mm foundation marker in each one. When you draw a line from any part of one your foundation markers to any part of the other, if any part of a model’s base (or any part of a model’s hull, for a model without a base) crosses that line, that model’s unit is said to be on your defensive line.

While an **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS** unit from your army is on your defensive line, that unit has the Against the Horde ability.

**Sustained Hits**

This ability always takes the form **[SUSTAINED HITS X]**. Each time an attack made with a **[SUSTAINED HITS]** weapon results in a **critical hit**, that attack results in a number of additional hits on the target as denoted by **X**.
***Example:** An attack made with a **[SUSTAINED HITS 2]** weapon results in a **critical hit**. That attack therefore hits the target three times (once from the **critical hit**, and twice more from the **[SUSTAINED HITS 2]** ability).*

Enhancements.Name: Vengeful Tread
Enhancements.Description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. Once per turn, you can target the bearer with the Tank Shock Stratagem for 0CP.

Enhancements.Name: Acquisitor-at-Arms
Enhancements.Description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. While the bearer is on your defensive line and there are no enemy units on your defensive line, add the bearer's Objective Control characteristic to that of each model affected by the bearer's Bondsman ability.

Enhancements.Name: Purgation's Hand
Enhancements.Description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. Each time the bearer makes a melee attack, if the bearer is on your defensive line, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

Enhancements.Name: Augury Halo
Enhancements.Description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. Each time the bearer makes a ranged attack, while the bearer is on your defensive line, weapons equipped by the bearer have the **[IGNORES COVER]** ability.

Rule.Title: Heroes of Legend
Rule.Text:
At the start of your turn, if your current Oath is fulfilled, determine an additional Oath, with the exception that you cannot select a Deed or Quality you have already selected (if you are randomly selecting the Deed and/or Quality and roll any result that you have already selected, select a Deed or Quality you have not already selected instead). If you cannot determine an additional Oath because you have already selected each Deed and each Quality, do not determine an additional Oath.

The Qualities from Oaths you have fulfilled continue to apply to all models in your army with the Code Chivalric ability. When the Deed for an additional Oath is completed, you instead gain 1CP, regardless of how you selected the Deed or Quality.

**Valour's Reward**

The Enhancements for this detachment can become expended. You cannot use such Enhancements while they are expended. Each time you fulfil your Oath, each expended Enhancement is no longer expended.

Enhancements.Name: Crushing Condemnation
Enhancements.Description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. When the bearer is selected to fight, after resolving its attacks, if one or more enemy units were destroyed by those attacks, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, this Enhancement is expended, then select one enemy unit that is not within Engagement Range of any units from your army and is within 12" of and visible to the bearer. Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

Enhancements.Name: Herald of Triumph
Enhancements.Description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. When the bearer ends a Charge move, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, this Enhancement is expended, the each enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.

Enhancements.Name: Wyrmslayer Divination
Enhancements.Description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. In your Shooting phase, when the bearer is selected to shoot, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, this Enhancement is expended, then until the end of the phase, each time it makes an attack that targets a unit that can FLY, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

Enhancements.Name: Pennant of Silvered Fury
Enhancements.Description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. When the bearer is selected to fight, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, this Enhancement is expended, then until the end of the phase, melee equipped by the bearer have the **[SUSTAINED HITS 2]** ability.

Rule.Title: Knightly Teachings
Rule.Text:
Each time a model from your army uses its Bondsman ability, if no other model from your army has used that Bondsman ability that turn, you can select up to three friendly ARMIGER models (instead of one) within 12" of that model, or within 15" of that model while your army is Honoured (you still cannot select a model that is already being affected by a Bondsman ability). Until the start of your next Command phase, those models are affected by that Bondsman ability.

**Keywords**

ARMIGER models from your army gain the BATTLELINE keyword.

Enhancements.Name: Martial Tuition
Enhancements.Description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. While two or more ARMIGER models are under the effects of the bearer's Bondsman ability, once per turn, you can target one of those ARMIGER models with the Counter-offensive Stratagem for 0CP.

Enhancements.Name: Mentor's Pride
Enhancements.Description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. While two or more ARMIGER models are under the effects of the bearer's Bondsman ability, each time each of those ARMIGER models makes an attack, you can re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

Enhancements.Name: Fables of Nightmare
Enhancements.Description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. While two or more ARMIGER models are under the effects of the bearer's Bondsman ability, melee weapons equipped by those ARMIGER models have the **[PRECISION]** ability.

Enhancements.Name: Tales of Heroism
Enhancements.Description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. While two or more ARMIGER models are under the effects of the bearer's Bondsman ability, each time one of those ARMIGER models makes a melee attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the Hit roll and/or the Wound roll.

Rule.Title: Knights of Legend
Rule.Text:
IMPERIAL KNIGHTS models from your army have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability. In addition, at the start of your Command phase, each IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model from your army regains 1 lost wound.

**Feel No Pain**

This ability always takes the form **Feel No Pain X+**. Each time a model with this ability would lose a wound, roll one D6: on an **X+**, that wound is not lost.

Enhancements.Name: Sanctuary
Enhancements.Description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. The bearer has a 5+ invulnerable save.

Enhancements.Name: Mysterious Guardian
Enhancements.Description:
IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. (Once per battle, per army) At the end of your opponent’s turn, if this unit is unengaged, you can use this ability. If you do:
- Place this unit in **strategic reserves**.
- This unit has **Deep Strike** until the start of your next Shooting phase.
- This unit must make an **ingress move** in your next Movement phase (including in your first turn).

Enhancements.Name: Bringer of Justice
Enhancements.Description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. Improve the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer by 2, and each time the bearer makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

Enhancements.Name: Hunter's Eye
Enhancements.Description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. Ranged weapons equipped by the bearer have the **[IGNORES COVER]** ability.

Rule.Title: Rain of Devastation
Rule.Text: Friendly **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS DOMINUS** units’ attacks that target a unit in a **terrain area** have +1 to **hit rolls**.

Enhancements.Name: Blessed Plate
Enhancements.Description: **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS DOMINUS** model only. This model has +1 **T**.

Enhancements.Name: Archeotech Autoloaders
Enhancements.Description: **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS DOMINUS** model only. This unit can re‑roll rolls to determine the **A** of a weapon.

Rule.Title: Driven From Their Lairs
Rule.Text:
While a friendly **ARMIGER** unit is affected by a **Bondsman** ability, that unit’s ranged attacks have **[IGNORES COVER]**.

This **detachment** has the **ARMIGERS** tag and cannot be taken with another **ARMIGERS detachment**.

Enhancements.Name: Gyro-optimised Actuators
Enhancements.Description: **ARMIGER** unit only. This unit has **MOBILE**.

Enhancements.Name: Ancestral Overbleed
Enhancements.Description: **ARMIGER** unit only. When you target this unit with the **Fire Overwatch/Heroic Intervention stratagem**, that use is ‑1 **CP**.

Rule.Title: Deathwatch Mission Tactics
Rule.Text:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one of the Mission Tactics found below. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Mission Tactic is active and its effects apply to all DEATHWATCH units in your army. Each Mission Tactic can only be selected once per battle.


**Furor Tactics**
While this Mission Tactic is active, weapons equipped by DEATHWATCH units from your army have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.


**Malleus Tactics**
While this Mission Tactic is active, weapons equipped by DEATHWATCH units from your army have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.


**Purgatus Tactics**
While this Mission Tactic is active, each time a DEATHWATCH model from your army makes an attack, on a Critical Wound, that attack has the [PRECISION] ability.

Rule.Title: Root Out Heresy
Rule.Text:
Ranged weapons equipped by ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITOR, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS and ORDO HERETICUS models from your army have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.


Each time an ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITOR, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS model from your army makes an attack that targets a CHAOS unit containing 5 or more models, that attack has the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

Rule.Title: Destroy the Daemonic
Rule.Text: Each time an INQUISITOR, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO MALLEUS model from your army makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and, if the target is a DAEMON unit, re-roll a Wound roll of 1 as well.

Rule.Title: At All Costs
Rule.Text:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one of the following to apply:


**Eliminate At All Costs**
Select one enemy unit on the battlefield. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time an AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM model from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.


**Acquire At All Costs**
Select one objective marker on the battlefield. Until the start of your next Command phase, while an AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit from your army is within range of that objective marker, improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in that unit by 1 and models in that unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.

Rule.Title: Extremis Sanction
Rule.Text:
OFFICIO ASSASSINORUM units from your army can use the Overkill, Soulless Horror and Shieldbreaker abilities twice per battle, instead of once per battle (but cannot use such an ability more than once in the same battle round).

When mustering your army, each OFFICIO ASSASSINORUM unit from your army has the relevant Extremis ability, and you must increase the points cost of each of those units by the amount shown. If this causes your army to exceed the points limit for the battle you are playing, you cannot include that unit in your army.
